question: Select the synonym of Ubiquitous.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Omnipresent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ubiquitous"** means something that is present, appearing, or found everywhere at the same time. (सर्वव्यापी)

 
 
• **Example:** Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that it’s hard to find someone without one.
 
 
 
• **"Omnipresent"** is a synonym for "Ubiquitous" and also means being present everywhere at the same time. (सर्वव्यापी)
 
 
• **Example:** The concept of love is omnipresent in poetry and literature.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Ubiquitous'** is **'Omnipresent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Omnipresent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Isolated** (अलग-थलग): Separated from others or alone.

 
 
• **Example:** The small village was isolated from the rest of the world due to the heavy snowfall.
 
 
 
• **Rare** (दुर्लभ): Something uncommon, infrequent, or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** Finding a four-leaf clover is considered rare and lucky.
 
 
 
• **Occasional** (कभी-कभी): Happening or done sometimes but not regularly.
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys an occasional cup of coffee in the evening.
